integrity: A complete proof and two standalone elementary finite-field verifiers are included. All claims are limited to the formulas and conditions proved. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact unrestricted radical-fiber identity does not evaluate the p-nilpotent radical count for arbitrary poset height; evaluated formulas apply at height at most p and to the first forbidden chain. The asymptotic holds along finite-field extensions in fixed characteristic; mathematical priority beyond inspected works is not certified. No independent audit performed.
title: Characteristic-resonant potent elements of finite incidence algebras and an antichain height law
